---
title: "7) Maps with Google Earth Engine"
lang: en
---

Alternative to the raw L2: use the **gridded L3** product
(`COPERNICUS/S5P/OFFL/L3_CH4`) in **Google Earth Engine (GEE)**, exporting via
**batch tasks** (avoids `Computation timed out` / `user memory limit`).

## ⚠️ Earth Engine credits and limits (read first)

::: {.callout-important}
### You NEED quota/credits to export

Each GEE export is a **queued task** and **consumes your project's quota**. If your
project has **no credits/quota available**, tasks will:

- **not run**, or stay stuck in `READY`/`RUNNING` for a long time;
- take **months** to finish a large period (2019 → today is ~90 monthly tasks).

Before firing the whole period, **confirm your quota** and run **a single test
month**.
:::

::: {.callout-tip}
If your quota is exhausted, use the **raw L2** ([previous page](06-mapas-l2.qmd)).
:::

## Requirements

Set `GEE_PROJECT` in `.env`.

::: {.lang-python}
```bash
pip install -e ".[gee]"
```
:::

::: {.lang-r}
```r
install.packages("rgee"); rgee::ee_install()
```
:::

## Authenticate (once)

::: {.lang-python}
```python
import ee
ee.Authenticate()                 # opens the browser (1st time only)
ee.Initialize(project="your-project")
```
:::

::: {.lang-r}
```r
library(rgee)
ee_Initialize()
```
:::

## Export the rasters

::: {.lang-python}
```python
import ee, geemap

COLLECTION = "COPERNICUS/S5P/OFFL/L3_CH4"
BAND = "CH4_column_volume_mixing_ratio_dry_air_bias_corrected"
DRIVE_FOLDER = "CH4_TROPOMI_Brasil"

brasil = (ee.FeatureCollection("FAO/GAUL/2015/level0")
          .filter(ee.Filter.eq("ADM0_NAME", "Brazil")).geometry())

ini = ee.Date.fromYMD(2022, 1, 1)
img = (ee.ImageCollection(COLLECTION)
       .filterDate(ini, ini.advance(1, "month"))
       .select(BAND).mean().clip(brasil).toFloat())

geemap.ee_export_image_to_drive(
    image=img, description="CH4_2022_01", folder=DRIVE_FOLDER,
    fileNamePrefix="CH4_2022_01", region=brasil.bounds(),
    scale=1113.2, crs="EPSG:4326", fileFormat="GeoTIFF")
```
:::

::: {.lang-r}
```r
library(rgee)

brasil <- ee$FeatureCollection("FAO/GAUL/2015/level0")$
  filter(ee$Filter$eq("ADM0_NAME", "Brazil"))$geometry()
banda <- "CH4_column_volume_mixing_ratio_dry_air_bias_corrected"

ini <- ee$Date$fromYMD(2022, 1, 1)
img <- ee$ImageCollection("COPERNICUS/S5P/OFFL/L3_CH4")$
  filterDate(ini, ini$advance(1, "month"))$
  select(banda)$mean()$clip(brasil)$toFloat()

ee_image_to_drive(
  image = img, description = "CH4_2022_01", folder = "CH4_TROPOMI_Brasil",
  fileNamePrefix = "CH4_2022_01", region = brasil$bounds(),
  scale = 1113.2, fileFormat = "GeoTIFF"
)$start()
```
:::

Track tasks and **quota/limits** at <https://code.earthengine.google.com/tasks>.

::: {.callout-warning}
If tasks sit idle, it is likely **quota**. Check the project limit before retrying.
:::
